description: Flexible EIA series lookup. Pass any EIA series ID (e.g. 'PET.RWTC.D' for WTI crude daily, 'NG.RNGWHHD.D' for Henry Hub spot daily, 'ELEC.PRICE.US-ALL.M' for US average electricity retail price monthly). Returns time-series data for that series. Use this when no other tool covers your specific need.

end.description: Inclusive upper-bound period (ISO date or YYYY-MM).

series_id.description: EIA series ID. See https://www.eia.gov/opendata/browser/ for the full catalog.

start.description: Inclusive lower-bound period (ISO date or YYYY-MM depending on series cadence).

name: eia_series_lookup
